summary.text: Marc Nozell is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Nozell is an information technology professional who, in a Ballotpedia survey, listed reducing property taxes, more available housing and strengthening public schools as his main messages.

paragraphs.text: Marc Nozell earned a bachelor's degree from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute in 1986, and his career experience includes working as an information technology professional.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Nozell said his campaign messages are reducing property taxes, increasing available housing and strengthening New Hampshire public schools.

He listed community development and family support, environmental protection and clean water, resilient infrastructure and digital privacy as areas of public policy he is passionate about, and said his campaign had been endorsed by AFT-NH, 350NH Action and Rights & Democracy NH.
